name: deckforge-agent-skills
description: Agent Skills for reliable editable browser-native presentations with semantic layouts, real editor and presenter modes, validation, and publishing workflows.

skills.title: DeckForge
skills.description: Primary orchestration skill for editable web-native presentation products with semantic layouts and enforceable delivery contracts.

skills.title: DeckForge Audit
skills.description: Review and quality-assurance skill for existing slide applications.

skills.title: DeckForge Runtime Planner
skills.description: Architecture planning skill for editor, presenter, and publishing runtime.

skills.title: DeckForge Publish
skills.description: Publishing, export, and release skill for browser-native slide apps.

skills.title: DeckForge Export
skills.description: Add or repair export capabilities (PowerPoint/PPTX, PDF, PNG, portable packages) for DeckForge-compatible or custom web slide applications.

skills.title: DeckForge Visual Evidence
skills.description: Verification worker that starts a DeckForge application in an isolated browser session and produces executed capability evidence.

skills.title: DeckForge Skill Evaluator
skills.description: Development evaluator comparing baseline, current, and candidate DeckForge skills on deterministic outcome tests.
